source_snapshot.title: Umm Al Quwain: Dh1,000 fine for trucks using prohibited roads
source_snapshot.text: Umm Al Quwain: Truck drivers heading to Umm Al Thuoob Industrial Area will face a Dh1,000 fine and four black traffic points if they use prohibited roads or restricted entrances, Umm Al Quwain Police have warned, as a new traffic arrangement comes into effect on December 1, 2026.Explaining the penalties, Umm Al Quwain Police said the violation falls under Article 10 of the Traffic Violations Regulations, which prohibits heavy vehicles from driving on or entering roads and areas where their movement is restricted. The penalty is a Dh1,000 fine and four black traffic points..Get updated faster and for FREE: Download the Gulf News app now - simply click here.The warning comes as police close the entrance opposite Exit 103 on Highway 311 to heavy vehicles, requiring truck drivers to follow a designated alternative route to reach Umm Al Thuoob Industrial Area.The General Command of Umm Al Quwain Police, through its Traffic and Patrols Department, announced the new traffic arrangement in a public advisory issued under the Ministry of Interior.Under the revised arrangement, trucks will no longer be permitted to use the entrance opposite Exit 103. Instead, drivers travelling along Highway 311 must continue to Exit 110 and take the return route towards Umm Al Quwain.They can then access Umm Al Thuoob Industrial Area through the designated entrance to the Free Trade Zone.. Police have installed a 'No Trucks' sign at the closed entrance, along with a traffic surveillance camera to monitor compliance with the new restriction.Authorities warned that drivers who fail to comply with the new traffic arrangement will face legal action and penalties under applicable UAE traffic laws and regulations.The Traffic and Patrols Department has urged heavy vehicle drivers to pay attention to road signs and use the designated alternative route.The measure aims to regulate heavy vehicle movements, improve road safety and ensure smoother traffic flow in the surrounding area..Umm Al Quwain changes truck access route to Umm Al Thuoob.Umm Al Quwain Police announce road closures ahead of New Year’s Eve celebrations.Umm Al Quwain offers 40% traffic fine discount for National Day.Sharjah Police announce new lanes for motorcycles, buses, and trucks from November 1

claims.claim: In Umm Al Quwain, fines will be introduced for trucks using prohibited roads.
From December 1, 2026, truck drivers heading to Umm Al Thuoob Industrial Area will be fined 1000 dirhams and receive four black traffic points for using prohibited roads or restricted entrances.
The entrance opposite Exit 103 on Highway 311 is closed to heavy vehicles.
Truck drivers must continue to Exit 110 and take a return route to the industrial area through a designated entrance to the Free Trade Zone.
Signs and cameras have been installed at the closed entrance to monitor compliance.

title: Umm Al Quwain: Dh1,000 fine for trucks using prohibited roads
summary_ru: 🚛 В Умм-эль-Кувейне введут штрафы за проезд грузовиков по запрещённым дорогам 📅 С 1 декабря 2026 года водители грузовиков, направляющихся в промышленную зону Умм Аль Тхуб, будут штрафоваться на 1000 дирхамов и получать четыре штрафных балла за использование запрещённых дорог или въезд через ограниченные въезды. 🚌 Въезд напротив съезда 103 на шоссе 311 для тяжёлых транспортных средств закрыт. Водителям необходимо проехать до съезда 110 и вернуться по альтернативному маршруту к промышленной зоне через специальный въезд в свободную торговую зону. На закрытом въезде установлены знаки и камеры для контроля соблюдения правил.
